study_type: moderated task-based usability / decision-comprehension test with async self-report fallback
preferred_population: finance operations, treasury, accounts payable/payments, finance manager or CFO users who review or approve business payments
proxy_rule: Adjacent operations, accounting, banking-operations, compliance or procurement-approval participants remain PROXY and may not be promoted to DIRECT_USER.
form_policy: Use FLUX-NATIVE-FORM.md as the only participant questionnaire for Round 01. Do not reuse, map or adapt the Nova form.
method_policy: MODERATED sessions may support observed-behavior evidence. ASYNC_SELF_REPORT responses remain self-report and may not be converted into observed task success, timing or moderator-help claims.
build_policy: Record the exact prototype URL/build used for every participant and do not silently change builds within a comparison round.
iteration_gate: Do not claim an evidence-driven iteration until verified real-session evidence is traceable. Prefer synthesis after 3-5 verified DIRECT_USER sessions; preserve PROXY evidence separately.
retest_gate: After a named decision changes, freeze the changed build and run the same affected task with new or explicitly marked returning participants before claiming improvement.
allowed_claims: A recruiter-facing design lens exists with decision pins, conceptual baseline/current comparison, a five-step tour and forced operational states
